finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts::vim `u` / `<c-r>` routing to the store history is untested
evidence: The claim is about coverage, and the supplied test files at this commit bear it out: packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:41-59 adds `routeVimHistoryToStore()` (global patch of `CodeMirror.commands.undo/redo`, gated on `noteStoreFacet` + `EditorView.editable`), but editor.test.ts only adds default-keymap tests ('routes undo/redo through the store', 'binds Mod-z / Mod-Shift-z', 'leaves history unbound on a read-only mount') plus the pre-existing vim test that merely calls `setKeymap('vim')` and asserts `getKeymap()`/`getText()` — no `u`/`<C-r>` press, no assertion that the store's undo ran, no fallback-path coverage. notes-undo-integration.test.ts and note-sync.test.ts likewise never touch vim. Since basicSetup's `history`/`historyKeymap` are now false, a regression in this routing would make vim undo a silent no-op with all tests still green, though the shipped code itself appears functionally correct, so the impact is a coverage gap rather than a live bug.
